# Design System & Tokens (Tier 0)

Create a minimal component library and tokens for consistent implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- design/tokens.json checked in with color, font, spacing tokens.
- Tailwind theme snippet integrated into app project and verified.
- Component examples: GradientGoldButton, ProductCard, CreatorCard, StyleBadge.

Success metric: Designers and engineers can implement UI using tokens; component examples exist in Storybook or a small demo screen.
